item.title: Poison Ivy, Poison Oak, and 7 Other Plants That Cause Rashes
item.description: Poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac are all known to cause an itchy rash. But they’re not the only plants that can irritate your skin. Get to know wood nettle, stinging nettle, leadwort, ragweed, giant hogweed, and more.

item.title: The Crucial Importance of Self-Care When You’re a Caregiver
item.description: Learn how to take care of yourself and find balance when caregiver burnout strikes.

item.title: What Causes Blood in Urine (Hematuria)?
item.description: Blood in urine, or hematuria, isn’t always serious, but it can be a sign health conditions affecting the kidneys, bladder, urinary tract, or prostate.

item.title: Surgery for Cataracts
item.description: Discover cataract surgery options, understand symptoms, and learn pre- and postsurgery care to improve your vision.

item.title: Can a Face Ice Bath Really Cure a Hangover, Bust Anxiety, Clear Skin, and More?
item.description: Dunking your face in a bowl of ice water for a few seconds might help with hangovers, skin problems, and anxiety, but the evidence is scarce. Learn more here.

item.title: Psoriatic Arthritis: Hand Strength, Dexterity, and Fine Motor Control
item.description: Learn how psoriatic arthritis affects hand function and discover strategies to improve strength, dexterity, and fine motor skills for better daily life quality.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ Heartthrob and ALS Advocate, Dies at 53
item.description: After he shared his diagnosis in 2025, the actor worked to raise awareness of the rare neurological disease. There is currently no cure for ALS.

item.title: What Is a Vegan Diet? A Comprehensive Beginner’s Guide
item.description: Discover the potential health benefits and risks of the vegan diet, including types of vegan diets, challenges when starting a vegan diet, tips, and a sample menu for meeting your nutritional needs.

item.title: 5 Core Exercises That Also Strengthen the Pelvic Floor
item.description: Learn how to effectively strengthen your pelvic floor with targeted core exercises. Physical therapists share moves to improve bladder function, sexual health, and reduce back pain.

item.title: Type 2 Diabetes Treatment: Medication, Lifestyle Changes, and More
item.description: From newer medications like Ozempic to lifestyle changes that stick, learn all about the different options for treating type 2 diabetes.
